name: 01-sessions
run:
W=preview-ws-$(date +%s) && mend run --project verify-fixture --name "$W" --detach --json -- sh -c 'mkdir -p .mend && cat > .mend/mend.toml <<TOML
[service.web]
command = "python3 -m http.server 8000"
port = 8000
browserScheme = "http"

[service.broken]
command = "echo broken starts and gives up; exit 3"
port = 8001
browserScheme = "http"
TOML
exec sleep 7204' && mend run --project verify-fixture --name "$W" --detach --json -- sleep 7205
